guide.title: {{name}}: fix the measurements
guide.step1: On the printed page, measure from the top-left corner of the paper to the first cross. It should be exactly 20 mm.
guide.step2: Enter the difference in the printer's shift. A cross printed 1 mm too far right needs left–right −1.
guide.step3: Print the page again and check that the cross is now at 20 mm.
